output:
## Direction
**Model:** M3 3D walkthrough / WebGL spatial backdrop
**Look:** Architectural Minimalism
**Stack:** Tier 1 standalone HTML/CSS/JS
**Motion craft:** Weighted response, spatial camera choreography, masked line reveal
**Why:** You asked for a scroll-driven walkthrough of three empty rooms with no 3D models, so M3 with Tier 1 inline Canvas 2D perspective projection renders the plain architectural geometry reliably offline without external libraries. Architectural Minimalism pairs warm stone (`#F2EFE9`) and deep charcoal (`#24211D`) with an inverted middle room to give each chamber a distinct spatial state.

## Scene plan
| # | Scroll | On screen | Motion | Still version |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0-33% | Room 1 establishing view on light ground with title | Camera holds then glides forward through Portal 1 | Static Room 1 section with title |
| 2 | 33-67% | Room 2 tight threshold view on inverted dark ground | Camera passes Portal 1, holds, then advances to Room 3 | Static Room 2 section on dark band |

## Prompt
```text
GOAL: An interactive 3D walkthrough website of an imaginary museum of silence where the visitor moves through three empty rooms on scroll to experience the sequence of spaces. One standalone offline index.html with inline CSS and JavaScript, drawing 3D rooms via pure inline Canvas 2D perspective projection or CSS 3D perspective (avoid raw WebGL shaders that fail in software renderers and emit zero external CDN script or module imports that fail on file://; leave Three.js as a later multi-file upgrade if models are added); a Google Fonts link is allowed.
CONTENT: Scene 1: "An imaginary museum of silence." and [ADD: name]. Scene 2: "Three empty rooms." Scene 3: "An imaginary museum of silence." and [ADD: name]. Add no other words or facts. Omit any [ADD: ...] slot completely (never invent a replacement name, subtitle, chapter title, or placeholder essay prose to fill a slot), and report it.
SCENES: Track 450vh. All percentages are of the whole track, from one progress value.
Motif: Three aligned architectural rooms in one-point perspective drawn in plain geometry: (a) main masses: three rectangular chambers (width 1.6x height, depth 2x height) in #F2EFE9 and #24211D with #6B4F3A reveals; (b) identifying parts: 3 sequential chambers along the z-axis, 2 centred rectangular doorway portals (40% width, 70% height) connecting them, 1 distant end wall with a centred recessed alcove, and 4 corner perspective edges per room; (c) surface detail: 1px #6B4F3A structural hairlines along floor-wall seams and portal frames, plus perspective floor shading that shifts tone when Room 2 inverts.
Scene 1 | 0-33% | 3D canvas left 60% width (mobile top 0-45%), camera at establishing distance (z = 0, FOV 55deg) framing Room 1 and Portal 1, field #F2EFE9 | camera holds at z = 0 through 26%, glides forward through Portal 1 (z = 0 -> 1.0, FOV 55deg -> 42deg) at 26-40%, field swaps #F2EFE9 -> #24211D at 32-34% | text hold 0-26, out 26-32
Scene 2 | 33-67% | 3D canvas right 60% width (mobile top 0-45%), camera tight inside Room 2 (z = 1.0, FOV 42deg) framing Portal 2's threshold edge, field inverted (#24211D ground, #F2EFE9 text/lines, #6B4F3A shapes) | camera holds at z = 1.0 through 60%, advances through Portal 2 into Room 3 (z = 1.0 -> 2.0, FOV 42deg -> 50deg) at 60-74%, field swaps #24211D -> #F2EFE9 at 66-68% | text in 34-40, hold 40-60, out 60-66
Scene 3 | 67-100% | closing lockup (desktop top 64% 3D canvas / bottom 36% centred text; mobile top 0-45% / bottom 52-94%), camera resting in Room 3 (z = 2.0, FOV 50deg) facing the distant alcove, field #F2EFE9 | camera eases to rest at z = 2.0 by 74% and holds still 74-100% | text in 68-74, hold 74-100
MOTION: p = clamp(-track.getBoundingClientRect().top / (track.offsetHeight - stage.offsetHeight), 0, 1). One track, one position: sticky; top: 0; height: 100svh stage, no ancestor with overflow hidden.
Smooth with drawn += (p - drawn) * (1 - exp(-dt / 120ms)); set drawn = p on load, resize and anchor jump. Every value is a pure function of drawn, so scrolling back reverses it.
Animate only transform, opacity and clip-path, eased cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) inside each range. Never prevent or replace native scroll.
Scene 1 is complete at 0% and the last scene at 100%. Outgoing text is at opacity 0 before incoming text appears. The motif stays visible through every hand-over.
Cap canvas devicePixelRatio at 2, pause rendering when off-screen via IntersectionObserver, and keep all copy in semantic HTML on dedicated non-overlapping safe zones.
LOOK: Ground #F2EFE9, text #24211D, accent #6B4F3A (shapes only, never text); inverted field swaps ground to #24211D and text to #F2EFE9; display and body Instrument Sans with sans-serif fallbacks. Display clamp(36px, 5.2vw, 144px). The main line of every scene, also a category or subject line, is display type: scale down cleanly inside 40% desktop columns or mobile frames so the longest word fits inside its container with at least 24px margin and zero right-edge clipping, and never under 36px. Body at least 16px, measure at most 60ch. Keep the stage and inverted background layer strictly behind both motif and text (background z-index 0, single motif layer z-index 1, text layer z-index 2); drive opacity on only ONE wrapper per scene so inner .copy/.mask elements stay at opacity 1 (never leaving Scene 1 hidden at p = 0); at p = 0 the stage starts in Scene 1's opening ground (never inverted at rest), and when a later scene inverts, drive ground, text and motif colours together through inherited root/stage CSS variables at every breakpoint (>= 4.5:1 contrast; never use filter invert alone and never hardcode dark text under mobile media queries). Line height 1.05 for display, 1.5 for body, mask padding 0.1em.
LAYOUT: Keep the 3D canvas strictly inside one persistent overflow-hidden stage box (z-index 1) with overflow-x clip on the stage so geometry never crosses behind text.
At 1440x900, before the last scene, place the 3D canvas box (width 60%, height 100%, overflow hidden) and the text column (width 40%, vertically centred) side by side in separate non-overlapping regions: Scene 1: canvas left, text right; Scene 2: canvas right, text left.
Scene 3 uses a centred closing lockup: a two-row grid or flex column of top 64% (minmax(0, 64%), overflow hidden) above bottom 36% (minmax(0, 36%)) at full width so the 3D canvas stays inside the top 64% box and the closing line sits centred in the bottom 36%.
At 390x844 and 360x640 the 3D canvas box is top 0 to 45% of the stage in every scene and text sits between 52% and 94%, with 24px gutters, centred in Scene 3. Text and 3D canvas never overlap, nothing is clipped, nothing scrolls sideways; shrink the display size until the longest line fits.
ASSETS: None: draw all three rooms in plain 3D geometry via inline Canvas 2D perspective projection or CSS 3D perspective. No stock, generated or placeholder media.
FALLBACKS: Base HTML and CSS is the static version: semantic sections in reading order (one still section per room), every word visible at opacity 1, sticky stage/track hidden (display none) until active, compact auto-height static sections (no 100svh spacer above text) above the fold with zero overlap; and when the active stage class IS set, hide the static fallback container (display none) so static copy never shows behind or beneath the stage. Keep keyboard scene-jump links visually hidden until focused (:focus-visible) unless a top navbar was requested, so only the active scene copy is shown at rest. JavaScript adds the class that turns on the stage only when prefers-reduced-motion is not reduce, switches live when that changes, and removes it if setup throws.
Keyboard: every link is reachable, has visible focus, and focusing it scrolls to the hold of its scene. A deep link lands on that hold. Reload and resize draw the state of the current position.
Failed or slow rendering over 300ms shows the static still with the text intact or a quiet role="status" line, never a blank screen.
AVOID: Sections that look like stacked template blocks while motion is on, scroll progress bars and decorative loading bars, card grids, glowing borders, neon or purple-blue gradients, pill badges, text on top of media, bounce, springs, scroll hijacking, cursor followers, and invented statistics, testimonials, logos or stock media.
DONE WHEN: At 0, 25, 50, 75 and 100% on 1440x900, 390x844 and 360x640 the screen matches SCENES, with no overlapping text, empty screen, sideways scroll or console error.
Reduced motion and no JavaScript show every word. Tab shows each link in view. Reload at 50% draws the 50% state. Report each check as passed, failed or not run.
```
